design_gotchas.title: Single-Letter Ordering Trap: SA vs SR/AP2210N Reverses Pins 1 & 3 (and LM3480 Differs Too)
design_gotchas.detail: AP7313-33SAG-7 (SA, SOT23, marking 'NZ') is 1=IN, 2=OUT, 3=GND, whereas sibling OPN AP7313-33SRG-7 (SR, SOT23R, marking 'SJ') and AP2210N-3.3TRG1 reverse Pins 1 and 3 to 1=GND, 2=OUT, 3=IN, and LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB uses 1=OUT, 2=IN, 3=GND. Never cross-substitute SA and SR suffixes on the same SOT-23-3 footprint.

design_gotchas.title: Current Limit and Short-Circuit Foldback Behavior at 150 mA Rating
design_gotchas.detail: Rated continuous output is 150 mA with current limit 200 mA min / 300 mA typ and foldback short-circuit current clamped to 50 mA when VOUT < 0.2 V. Heavy capacitive loads or surge rails exceeding 200 mA during startup can trip foldback limiting.

design_gotchas.title: 65 uA Quiescent Current Limits Always-On Coin-Cell Battery Life
design_gotchas.detail: No-load IQ is 55 uA typ (75 uA max) and 65 uA typ at 150 mA load, with no shutdown pin to cut standby current. For micro-amp sleep budgets, a nanopower LDO or EN-controlled regulator is required.

design_gotchas.title: Verify 10–200 mOhm Output Capacitor ESR Window
design_gotchas.detail: Diodes Inc specifies 1 uF to 4.7 uF X5R/X7R ceramic capacitors with 10 mOhm to 200 mOhm ESR placed close to OUT and GND pins for clean transient response and stability.

typical_use_cases: 150 mA 3.3 V auxiliary rails in notebook/desktop peripherals and LAN cards
Compact 3-pin SOT-23-3 local logic rails using 1 uF X5R/X7R ceramic capacitors
Fast-transient portable digital sub-rails (80 us startup, 150 mV typical dropout)
Pin-compatible lower-current sibling to AP7333-33SAG-7 on SA (1=IN, 2=OUT, 3=GND) layouts
engineering_summary: The Diodes Incorporated AP7313-33SAG-7 is a 150 mA fixed 3.3 V (±2%) LDO regulator in the standard SA SOT-23-3 package with Pin 1=IN, Pin 2=OUT, and Pin 3=GND. Operating from 2 V to 6 V (7 V abs max), it delivers 150 mV typical dropout at 150 mA, 55 uA no-load / 65 uA full-load IQ, 65 dB PSRR at 100 Hz, and stability with a 1 uF ceramic output capacitor (10–200 mOhm ESR). Its SA pinout matches AP7333-33SAG-7 (and shares the 207 °C/W θJA / 600 mW rating) but is strictly incompatible with AP7313-33SRG-7 / AP2210N-3.3TRG1 (1=GND, 2=OUT, 3=IN) and LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB (1=OUT, 2=IN, 3=GND).
